using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Args;

public class CommandLineArgs
{
    public string Target { get; }
    public CommandLineOptions Options { get; }

    public CommandLineArgs(string target, CommandLineOptions options)
    {
        Target = target;
        Options = options;
    }

    public CommandLineArgs(string[] args)
    {
        if (args == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(args));
        }

        Target = args.Length > 0 ? args[0] : null;
        Options = new CommandLineOptions(args.Skip(1).ToArray());
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Args;

public class CommandLineOptions : Dictionary<string, string>
{
    public CommandLineOptions()
    {
    }

    public CommandLineOptions(string[] args)
    {
        if (args == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(args));
        }

        for (var i = 0; i < args.Length; i++)
        {
            if (args[i].StartsWith("-"))
            {
                var key = args[i].TrimStart('-');
                var value = i + 1 < args.Length && !args[i + 1].StartsWith("-") ? args[i + 1] : null;
                this[key] = value;
                if (value != null)
                {
                    i++;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public string GetOrNull(string shortOption, string longOption)
    {
        if (TryGetValue(longOption, out var value))
        {
            return value;
        }

        if (TryGetValue(shortOption, out value))
        {
            return value;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
